items.title: Updated: Sustainability leadership moves
items.summary: As corporate sustainability matures, some long-time leaders are leaving the profession, while others are tackling a broader set of responsibilities following reorganizations or layoffs.

items.title: Inside Workday’s second round of science-based targets
items.summary: Enterprise software firm Workday has adopted fresh greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions reduction commitments across most of its carbon footprint after meeting two of three pledges it made in 2020.

items.title: Sustainability Uncovered episode 50: Raising sustainability standards and Earthshot Prize breakthroughs
items.summary: The latest episode of edie’s long-standing Sustainability Uncovered podcast is now live.

items.title: Can Europe afford to weaken EV policies as businesses push for electrification?
items.summary: European policymakers face competing demands from automotive manufacturers, who want greater flexibility, and organisations that argue weakening existing targets could undermine industrial competitiveness and energy security.

items.title: UK urged to unlock waste heat sources to decarbonise heating
items.summary: A new report has called for coordinated policy reforms to overcome commercial barriers, attract investment and make heat recovery the norm across the UK's growing heat network sector.

items.title: Sustainability reporting must do more to inform board decisions, finds WBCSD
items.summary: Although sustainability reporting has matured, new analysis from the World Business Council for Sustainable Development (WBCSD) has found that boards and investors may not see the data they need to drive better decisions.

items.title: Win a free VIP pass to edie 27: Take our sustainability snapshot survey
items.summary: Sustainability professionals have the chance to win six months of access to edie’s digital Membership offering as well as a VIP pass to edie 27 in April by completing a short survey.

items.title: ON TUESDAY: How AI can accelerate investment in climate solutions
items.summary: Join us next week for an edie webinar exploring how artificial intelligence (AI), market intelligence and human expertise can help businesses identify credible climate investment opportunities and secure the financial backing needed to turn sustainability ambitions into action.

items.title: Experts: How are climate scientists using artificial intelligence?
items.summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is developing at a rapid pace and is increasingly being used by scientists to better understand climate change.
